notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Optimised human game modes. Should now be possible to play HvH modes without dropping to 20 fps lol

notes.title: SPRING UPDATE 2.2.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Improved reconciliation for client side prediction. Movement corrections from the server should no longer be able to cause massive rubber banding chains when playing as drone.
[*]Heavily nerfed human move speed
[*]Added interpolation between fixed movement updates for local player, to make movement more smooth.
[*]Removed snow and winter objects.
[*]Added slight smoothing to human recoil (might be improved further in later updates)
[*]Added the option to set grass density and render distance. However, this can have massive impact on performance at this point. So in case of low frame rate, it is recommended to turn grass density down to 0.
[*]Added clouds.
[*]Improved scoreboard UI
[*]Other minor UI changes
[*]Changed server configs path from game data path to game directory.
[/list]

notes.title: xMas Winter Update v2.1.0
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added xMas and Winter Content.
[*] Reduced human in air movement.
[*] Fixed human jump logic to be fully deterministic in order to avoid rubber banding when jumping.
[*] Minor bugfixes.
[/olist]

notes.title: PATCH 2.0.1.6
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added shotgun specific tracer effects.
[*]There are now 6 different shotgun patterns which are dynamically created individually for each client.
[*]Added different shoot SFX for shotgun and sniper.
[*]Tweaked Lag compensation(Server rewinding) to work better with the movement sendrate limits implemented in the last update.
[*]Tweaked movement syncing for remote clients to now be tick based instead of individual for each client to prevent lag compensation from being randomly inaccurate.
[*]Fixed an issue in the human movement script.
[*]Fixed an issue were the green drone skin would make the drone fuselage invisible.
[*]Fixed an issue were remote human players shoot sound effects wouldn't play
[*]Enabled 'Stop NaNs' on drone camera, to temporarly silence some NaN issues until the cause has been 100% fixed.
[/list]

The shotgun patterns are played in order and were added to work with the shotgun tracer effects, to avoid the client having to wait for the server to send back the shot impact points, which would look unresponsive unless the round trip time is very low.

notes.title: DRONE WARS 2.0 RELEASE
notes.notes:
[h1]Drone Wars 2.0 was made entirely from scratch and is technically a whole new game.[/h1]

[h3]So what's new? Well literally everything, but here are some of the most important improvements 2.0 comes with:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New custom networking.
[*]New and better movement which is now server authoritative, with client side prediction, server side reconciliation and server rewinding(lag compensation) and is thereby way more secure.
[*]Humans are now a playable class.
[*]The drone model has  also been recreated from scratch and the overall look of the game has improved by a lot.
[*]Way better looking UI (especially the main menu).
[*]A voting system, so each player can vote for the next game mode at the end of each round.
[*]Some new inventory items.
[/list]

[h2]Watch the latest devlog:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=sqa3rve0J0A;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

It's, main feature is the new flying system, that still needs some improvements though. Also we might add Drones vs Humans, some new weapons and the progression system in this update, and if we do that, it will take A LOT more time anyways.

notes.title: LARGER CONTENT UPDATE 1 (v 1.2.0.0.0)
notes.notes:
[u][b]Update contains:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*]Reworked in-game UI controlling
[*]Improved some UI elements
[*]Added global stats/leaderboards. The new leaderboard will automatically sync with the current stats, so you will keep your progress.

[*]Implemented Premium edition features.
[*]Implemented a lot of new skins and reworked the game’s econ system.
[*]Reworked round end screen, and added score display to it.
It should now get displayed for everyone every time now.

[*]Made in-game scoreboard dynamic, it sorts players by WP score now.
[*]In-game scoreboard now displays the local player UI item blue.
[*]Added reload UI animation
[*]Improved reload cooldown particle effect.
[*]Tweaked reload animation to be timed correctly with the reload time.
[*]Upgraded projects unity version. This has caused a lot of new issues, but most of them should be fixed by now.

[*]Tweaked broken glass issues at gas station door.

[*]Added dropdowns for anti-aliasing, and VSync mode to Video menu.
[*]Setted VSync mode to "Don't sync" by default.
[*]Changed Season from Winter to spring/summer
[*]Added intro/tutorial UI element + Hold F1 for more info UI element
[*]Added Spectator mode to arena mode.
[*]Added UI button press SFX
[*]Added GUI darkmode(for non-premium users as well)
[/list]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bunch of collision matrix issues eg. you could die from the kill zone on arena after already being dead.

[*]Arena kill zone syncing method reworked. The issue where clients that were inside the circle and far away from the zone still got affected by it should now be fixed.
However there could still be an issue, that you get damage when you are really close to the zone.
[/list]

[u][b]Plans for the next larger content updates before final release:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*]General map detail improvements.
[*]combat system rework. (Maybe  add some more drone character classes)
[*]flying mechanics rework.
[*]Drones vs Humans game modes.
[*]General improvements and bugfixes.
[/list]

We will try to create better flying mechanics, but we don't want to make it to hard to control, but we also want to make it more like actually flying, not just like hovering and jumping.

Drones vs Humans, we will try our best, to implement DvsH game modes, before final release, but it will be a hard task to do, because when I started working on this game, I did never plan to implement Human characters.

[b]Plans for smaller updates and events[/b]

[list]
[*]1. April update :)
[*] in-game events like eg. tournements, weapon  changes, health changes etc.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.0.12
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Made local admin system much more secure, by adding an admin session key system.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Fixed local banning system, and all the other local admin commands, for local admin menu.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Fixed server welcome message.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Fixed server audio issues, the server console is now muted and should not make any game sounds anymore.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Tweaked in-game server list, to not say "Game mode: Deathmatch" when server is running on "Auto Change"(Which changes the game mode after each round).
[/list]

[list]
[*]Added server console log file to the "Server_configs" file. It will store the console outputs from the server console, but it will override it when restarting the server.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Fixed and tweaked a bunch of server console commands.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Tweaked Server console output, to be less confusing and misleading.
[/list]


So with this Patch(V 1.0.0.12), the first phase on our roadmap should be completed, and all the most problematic bugs, and local admin security issues should be fixed.
This means we will enter the next phase on our roadmap(Major update/mega patch 1), this means there won't be any updates for the next 1-3 months, because the content of this major update, will take a lot of time to do. However I am not sure if it is a good idea to have such a long update pause, and then one huge update. So the alternative would be, that we try to split Major update/Mega patch 1 up into a bunch of smaller updates, and try to update the game once in a week, eg. each friday. 

What would you prefer?

You can join our [url=https://discord.gg/dZVgpA9]Discord server[/url], and vote in the announce channel, or write a comment with your opinion in the comment section of this patch note.
